dedupe_keys.name: finite element models of masonry lap splice panels and out of plane wall with grade 80 rebars and fiber reinforced grout

description: Finite element models of masonry lap-splice panels and out of plane wall with Grade 80 rebars and fiber-reinforced grout is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This DesignSafe publication presents a set of finite element (FE) model files developed to simulate the behavior of masonry lap-splice specimens reinforced with Grade 80 steel bars embedded in fiber-reinforced grout. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: finite element models, fiber-reinforced grout, masonry lap-splice, multi-hazard, Grade 80 rebars. Published 2026-04-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
